reason: A local DSH model-request preflight utility that scans assembled requests for likely credentials and unscannable content, blocking downstream dispatch according to configurable fail-closed policies without sending request content to another service.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DSH 模型请求出站前本地扫描疑似凭据和不可扫描内容，并按配置阻止下游模型调用的预检插件。
summaries.en: A local DSH preflight plugin that scans assembled model requests for likely credentials and unscannable content, then blocks downstream dispatch according to configurable policies.

capabilities: inspects assembled model request data locally
blocks downstream model dispatch when policy conditions match
can bypass checks for configured providers or request purposes
